checks.message: Provisional boundary is clearly labeled and isolated from official/statutory claims.
All three required key areas remain provisional and visibly disclosed.
Seven land-use features form a complete non-overlapping partition of the submitted boundary.
Every scenario declares a non-digital basic interface before optional personalization.
All twelve scenarios include visible human review, service or shutdown paths.
Ordinary public-space access does not require facial recognition or a unified personal profile.
Specialist and user review remains an explicit gate; no compliance certification is claimed.
Four industry testing and validation scenarios are provided.
Four AI pilgrimage, contribution or honor nodes are provided.
Static offline HTML uses local images and no active or remote content.
Proposal cites standards, depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions.
Narrative, translations, geometry, brand, figures, PDFs, HTML, structured data, official citations, background cases, fonts and toolchain have separate authorship, licence and limitation records.
Registry-approved formal uses, background-only references and provisional-only geometry are explicitly separated.

AI-assisted author-side comparison covers section order, claims, numbers, units, evidence markers, figures, source roles and provisional warnings; independent human publication sign-off remains truthfully pending.
P1-P6 define RACI, concept cost classes, procurement assumptions, suggested test gates, SLA, reassessment and exit without presenting them as statutory standards or commitments.
Five participant roles, staged settings, consent, privacy, receipts, veto and professional final-judgement boundaries are specified; no completed real-user evidence is claimed.
